sentences.text:
Smt. Sangita Salawat vs Orienetal Insurance Co. Ltd on 8
November, 2024
 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Ind:31737
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Indore

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Gajendra Singh

On The 8 th Of November, 2024
 Misc. Appeal No. 1666 of 2021
 Smt. Sangita Salawat And Others
 Versus
 Orienetal Insurance Co. Ltd And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri
Ashwin Patidar - learned counsel for the appella  Shri Pankaj Kumar Jain, learned counsel for the respo  Company.

ORDER This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 is preferred being aggrieved by the award dated 21.01.2021 passed in MACC No.1180/2018 by the Additional Member, MACT,
Indore for enhancement of Rs.7,00,000/- compensation.

02. Short controversy in this appeal is that deceased Mangilal Salawat died in motor vehicular accident when he himself was driving Eicher Vehicle bearing Registration No.MP-09-GG-8229 and that vehicle collided with Eicher Vehicle bearing Registration No.MP-09-GG-5796 owned and driven by respondent no.2/Abbas and insured by respondent no.1/Oriental Insurance Company.
03 . A claim seeking compensation of Rs.20,00,000/- was preferred.

The claim was contested by the respondent no.1/insurance company only and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31737 2 MA-1666-2021 after recording the evidence Tribunal awarded a total compensation of Rs.7,77,000/-
with the interest rate of 6% per annum from the date of application in the following heads which are mentioned below:-
Loss of Dependency :- Rs.7,00,000/-
(Rs.5,000/- x 12 = 60000 + 25% = Rs.75,000 - 1/3 = 50000 x 14) Loss of Consortium :-
Rs.40,000/-
 Funeral Expenses :- Rs.15,000/-
 Loss of estate :- Rs.15,000/-
Smt. Sangita Salawat vs Orienetal Insurance Co. Ltd on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34768914/
1 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TOTAL Rs.7,77,000/-
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
04.

This appeal has been preferred mainly on the ground that the tribunal has not considered the exhibit-P/18 which is the license of transport vehicle and ought to have awarded the compensation on the basis of his income as skilled labour and ought to have awarded consortium to the appellant no.2 & 3 who are the minor children of the deceased.
05. Counsel for the respondent have opposed the prayer submitting that no proof of income has been adduced.

06. Tribunal has assessed the income only payable to un-skilled labour recording the finding that the driving license placed on record is only to drive light motor vehicles, it is not to drive the heavy vehicle.

07. Perusal of Exhibit-P/18 discloses that a driving license issued by the Regional Transport Office,
Indore is issued to the deceased Mangilal to drive light transport vehicle and that was valid upto 10.10.2020 and deceased NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31737 3 MA-1666-2021 Mangilal died when he was driving a goods vehicle.

Accordingly, the finding of the Tribunal is recorded without appreciating the Exhibit-P/18 and the compensation of accident, therefore, the income of the deceased is assessed on the basis of skilled labour which was Rs.9,360/- per month.

25% for future prospect ought to have added which comes to Rs.2,340/- i.e. Rs.11,700/- after deducted 1/3 for personal expenses and applying the multiplier of 14 a total loss of dependency is calculated as Rs.13,10,400/-.

Both the minor children are entitled for consortium of Rs.80,000/-
(Rs.40,000/- each).
Accordingly, a total compensation of Rs.14,30,400/- is calculated.
The tribunal has awarded Rs.7,70,000/-.
Thus, an award of Rs.6,67,400/- - is further enhanced with the interest rate of 6% per annum from the date of application i.e. 26.03.2018 08.

Accordingly, M.A.No.1666/2021 is disposed of.
09.
With the copy of this order, the record of the Tribunal be returned back.
C.C as per Rules.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE VS Smt. Sangita Salawat vs Orienetal Insurance Co. Ltd on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34768914/
